summary: Iter18: i18n unification (JA/EN/PT). Backend error localization via X-Lang header validated end-to-end: pytest 17/17 pass covering wrong-password (401), 422 Pydantic validation, missing/unknown X-Lang default to JA, and login-smoke across 3 roles × 3 langs. Frontend browser test verifies wrong-pwd toast localized in all 3 langs, dashboard 'FINORA AI INSIGHT' title, sidebar 'プレミアムプラン/Premium Plan/Plano Premium', welcome prefix EN/PT, Portfolio 現在評価額, Liabilities 現在残高, Platform FINORA運営. i18n_audit.mjs reports DUP KEYS 0 / MISSING KEYS 0.

issues: Displays 'Ryuichi Kurozaki 様' rather than '黒崎 龍一 様'. i18n suffix (' 様') is applied correctly — the underlying user record for ryuichi.kurozaki@gmail.com stores its name in Roman letters. If the JP UI is expected to render kanji, update the user record (users.name → '黒崎 龍一') or add a separate name_ja field. Not an i18n key bug.
Pre-existing React hydration warning persists: <span data-ve-dynamic> nested inside <option> in header-client-selector. Same as iter17. Cosmetic (instrumentation wrapper) but pollutes console.
Recharts throws many 'width(-1)/height(-1)' warnings during initial paint before container measures. Not blocking, but noisy.

action_items: LOW: (Data, not i18n) Update user record for ryuichi.kurozaki@gmail.com so JA dashboard renders '黒崎 龍一 様' — or accept 'Ryuichi Kurozaki 様' as expected.
LOW: Clean up <span> inside <option> in header-client-selector (Layout.jsx:95) — instrumentation-only, still surfaces hydration error.
critical_code_review_comments: backend/i18n_errors.py cleanly stores EN as source-of-truth with (ja, pt) tuples and a small regex table for parameterised strings; lang_of() safely coerces missing/unknown header → 'ja'. Good.

server.py wires both StarletteHTTPException and RequestValidationError handlers through tr_error / VALIDATION → 422 returns a single localized string (not the standard FastAPI array), which is nicer for UI toasts.
frontend/src/lib/api.js sets cfg.headers['X-Lang'] on every request from localStorage.finora_lang (default 'ja') — confirmed at browser layer.

i18n dicts (dict.js/billing.js/features.js/landing.js): confirmed keys: balance=現在残高, issue=課題, fee=手数料, current_value=現在評価額, goal_current_value=現在値（空欄で自動）, internal=社内タスク, vis_internal=自分のみ, vis_shared=相手と共有, ai_title=FINORA AI INSIGHT, landing_ai_title='AIの回答は、根拠が見える。', inv_balance=未入金, contract_fee=料金（税抜）, platform=FINORA運営, premium_plan=プレミアムプラン, required_suffix=：必須項目です. All present with correct EN/PT companions.

i18n_audit.mjs: 0 duplicate keys, 0 missing keys. 'BAD ENTRIES' (welcome_prefix/suffix, count_unit, people_unit) are intentional (JP-only suffix particles / counters) — the audit's flagging is a false positive and can be whitelisted.

server error path: verified via pytest that wrong login → 401 detail is '{ja: 'メールアドレスまたはパスワードが正しくありません', en: 'Invalid email or password', pt: 'E-mail ou senha incorretos'}'; unknown/missing lang → ja.
Regression smoke (all 3 langs × 3 roles admin/consultant/client login): all 9 login combinations return 200 — no login regression from the i18n changes.

success_rate.frontend: 100% of localization checks (14/14) — the 2 initially-failing checks were test-setup artifacts (welcome-name is user-record data; /landing redirects when logged in)

seed_data_creation: None. All wrong-pwd tests use ephemeral emails (nobody-qa-t2*@example.com) so real accounts are not brute-force-locked.
context_for_next_testing_agent: i18n error localization is now fully covered by /app/backend/tests/test_i18n_errors.py (pytest -o addopts= to bypass the -n loadscope from pytest.ini). Frontend adds X-Lang from localStorage.finora_lang on every request via /app/frontend/src/lib/api.js. If new HTTPException messages are added in backend, they MUST be added to M dict in /app/backend/i18n_errors.py or they will fall through as English on JA/PT UIs. Landing-page verification requires logout first — logged-in visitors to /landing bounce to /dashboard.
rca of the issue: N/A — no bug found in i18n unification. One minor data/UX observation: the JA dashboard welcome shows 'Ryuichi Kurozaki 様' instead of the requested '黒崎 龍一 様' because the users.name field for that account stores the Roman form; i18n prefix (empty for JA) + user.name + suffix ' 様' is applied correctly.
